cheap|You triage Indian stock-exchange filings for a busy portfolio investor. For each filing, read the excerpt and return: category (one of: results, M&A, fund_raise, management_change, litigation, insider_trading, earnings_call, investor_meetings, credit_rating, dividend, bonus_split, capex, press_release, postal_ballot, agm_egm, pledging, unclassified), tier ('act' = could move the stock or changes the thesis; 'know' = worth a glance; 'routine' = compliance paperwork), and one_liner: ONE sentence, max 22 words, with the concrete fact (numbers, names, amounts, dates). No hype, no advice, no 'the company informed the exchange'. If the excerpt is boilerplate, say what it actually is. ### id=106834102 | ASIANPAINT | exchange category: Press Release
subject: Please find enclosed the Press Release on the performance of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026.
excerpt: Sub: Outcome of Board Meeting in accordance with the SEBI (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ("Listing Regulations") - Financial 
Results & Interim Dividend 
The Board of Directors at its meeting held today, i.e., Thursday, 29th October 2026, has, interalia, 
approved the following: 
(a) Audited standalone and unaudited consolidated financial results of the Company for the 
quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026; and 
(b) Payment of interim dividend of Rs. 5.75 (Rupees five and paise seventy-five only) per equity 
share of the face value of Re. 1 (Rupee one) each for the financial year ending 31 st March 
2027. The record date for interim dividend has been fixed as Wednesday, 4th November 2026, 
and the dividend will be paid to the shareholders on or after Friday, 13th November 2026. 
Accordingly, please find enclosed the following:

items.one_liner: Polycab India Limited announced an investor/analyst meeting on 29‑Oct‑2026.
Asian Paints approved audited results for Q1 & H1 2026 and interim dividend of Rs.5.75 per share, record date 4‑Nov‑2026.
Infosys announced 37 winners of the 13th Qorus‑Infosys Finacle Banking Innovation Awards on 29‑Oct‑2026.
Sun Pharma announced U.S. approval of ILUMYA® (tildrakizumab‑asmn) for psoriatic arthritis on 30‑Oct‑2026.
Bajaj Finance allotted 2,06,950 NCDs at Rs.1 lakh each, raising Rs.2,069.501 crore on 30‑Oct‑2026.
Sun Pharma appointed Deloitte Haskins & Sells as statutory auditors for 5 years starting FY2026‑27.
